user.title: Add a BM2 battery
user.description: Select the ESPHome voltage sensors for this physical battery. Include every receiver. The battery may be away during setup; its Bluetooth connection is tested on the first recovery.

data_description.battery_id: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. Used in the permanent history statistics ID.
data_description.voltage_sources: Select receiver sensors, never this integration's own voltage sensor.

error.invalid_mac: Enter an address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_battery_id: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, without leading/trailing underscores.
error.duplicate_battery_id: This battery ID is already in use.
error.no_sources: Select at least one ESPHome voltage sensor.
error.recursive_source: Select ESPHome receiver sensors, not BM2 canonical sensors.
